property.title: Skyline Villa with Pool Deck
property.description: A sunlit hillside villa with floor-to-ceiling glass, a private pool terrace, and Arabian Sea views. Open living spaces flow into a chef's kitchen, while the primary suite opens onto a landscaped courtyard. Ideal for buyers who want resort living without leaving the city.

property.title: Riverfront 3T Apartment
property.description: A bright corner apartment with a wraparound balcony over the Sabarmati. Neutral interiors, a modular kitchen, and two parking slots. The tower has 24/7 security and a clubhouse, making it an easy lock-and-leave rental for professionals.

property.title: Garden Courtyard Family House
property.description: A contemporary independent house organised around a central courtyard garden. Four bedrooms, a double-height living room, and a study that can convert to a guest suite. Quiet lane, walking distance to cafes and schools.

property.title: Downtown Studio Office Loft
property.description: A fitted office loft in a Grade-A tower with reception, two meeting rooms, and an open work bay for twelve. Floor-to-ceiling glazing, dedicated parking, and building amenities that support client visits throughout the week.

property.title: Harbour View Penthouse
property.description: A full-floor penthouse with a private terrace overlooking the Queen's Necklace. Italian stone floors, a wine room, and a service lift. Currently under offer; viewings continue by appointment while documentation is reviewed.

property.title: Palm Grove Weekend Villa
property.description: A palm-lined weekend villa ten minutes from the beach, with a lap pool, outdoor kitchen, and staff quarters. Sold subject to registration; listed here so buyers can review comparable inventory nearby.
